shortBio.en: Pink Floyd drummer from the start; only constant member across all studio eras.
shortBio.zh: Pink Floyd 从一开始的鼓手；各录音室阶段唯一始终在册成员。

body.en:
Born 1944. Drummer on every Pink Floyd studio era. Keeps the pulse under long-form and concept pieces.

Later Saucerful of Secrets live projects revisit early material.
body.zh:
1944 年生。Pink Floyd 各录音室阶段鼓手。在长曲与概念作品下托住节奏。

后来的 Saucerful of Secrets 现场项目重访早期曲目。
